name: How can I prevent mold from returning to my attic after remediation?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold from returning to my attic after remediation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold recurrence requires addressing the original moisture source. This includes repairing roof leaks, improving attic ventilation with proper intake and exhaust vents, sealing air leaks from living spaces into the attic, and ensuring adequate insulation. Regularly inspecting your attic for signs of moisture or damage can help catch potential issues early.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by fixing roof leaks, improving attic ventilation, sealing air leaks, and ensuring proper insulation. Regular inspections help catch issues early.
